coffee_name: Maillard’s Dream – Kerehaklu 62H Mosto Culture Naturals – Fine Robusta
tasting_notes: Caramelised, nutty, and baked flavour compounds with butter cookies, cashew, and malt character
description_raw: Maillard’s Dream celebrates the transformation that happens when fermentation innovation meets precision roasting. Named after the Maillard reaction — the browning process responsible for building caramelized, nutty, and baked flavor compounds in coffee — this lot was designed to amplify those sensory cues. At Kerehaklu Estate, Pranoy Thipaiah pushed Robusta processing forward using a mosto-cultured fermentation, reintroducing active microbes from previous fermentations to intensify sugar conversion and aromatic complexity. This layered foundation translated beautifully in the roaster, where controlled heat development unlocked notes of butter cookies, malt, cashew, and pastry. The result is a rich, textured cup that bridges science, craft, and flavor — proving once again that progressive processing and thoughtful roasting can redefine what Robusta is capable of becoming.

tasting_notes: Candied orange, honeysuckle, nectarine, and tea rose with aromatic clarity and subtle floral complexity
description_raw: At Kerehaklu Estate, Pranoy Thipaiah continues to refine his expertise with cultured fermentations, using selected starters to guide flavor development with precision and consistency. These cultures enhance aromatic clarity, shape acidity, and unlock subtle floral complexity that rewards brewers who enjoy dialing in extraction and exploring nuance. Controlled polyhouse drying further elevates quality by protecting the coffee from environmental fluctuations and ensuring slow, even moisture reduction for greater stability and sweetness. Our light filter roast was designed to let these attributes shine — allowing florals to sparkle alongside bright acidity, while a clean medium mouthfeel preserves clarity and definition in the cup.

coffee_name: Pichia Parables  – Harley 36H Pichia Yeast Naturals
tasting_notes: Syrupy, fruit-forward espresso with figs, mango, mosambi, and walnut; remarkably sweet but balanced
description_raw: Yeast-driven fermentations have reshaped how flavor develops in coffee, with each strain influencing acidity, sweetness, and aromatic complexity in its own distinct way. Pichia Parables explores this idea through a controlled Pichia yeast fermentation that highlights clarity and layered fruit expression. At Harley Estate, experimentation remains central — pushing boundaries with innovative processing methods that reveal new dimensions of origin character. We employed a deliberately slow and gradual roast profile, extending development time to deepen caramelisation and encourage complex sugar transformation, which in turn enhances sweetness, body, and nuance. The result is a syrupy, fruit-forward espresso with a remarkably sweet but balanced profile.

tasting_notes: Bold, juicy with blueberry jam, dried figs, papaya, and wild honey; layered fruit sweetness with sticky, jammy finish
description_raw: Kraken Jam is here. The follow-up to Dragon Jam — and yes, it’s every bit as wild. From the exceptional collection of naturals crafted by Navin & Ashok Rajes at Orchardale Estate, this coffee is crafted for espresso lovers who enjoy bold, juicy, and unapologetically indulgent shots. It brews bold, hits with layered fruit sweetness, and leaves behind that sticky, jammy finish we all chase. If Dragon Jam lived on your bar, Kraken Jam belongs there too. This is the kind of coffee that rewards curiosity — tweak your ratios, play with extraction, pull it short or stretch it out. It holds up beautifully and keeps giving back. For those who love syrupy shots, dessert-like cups, and coffees that feel larger than life — this one’s for you.

coffee_name: Sweet Illusions – BEWILD Permaculture 180H Anoxic Naturals – Fine Robusta
tasting_notes: Delicate jasmine florals, red mace spice, and lasting sweetness with champakali and cherry notes
description_raw: Sweet Illusions is where Robusta decides to break the rules — and we’re here for it. Grown at BEWILD Coffee’s Poomale Estate under long-term permaculture farming, this lot turns expectation on its head with delicate florals and lasting sweetness that feel almost impossible for the species. Our omni roast lets it shine everywhere: V60, AeroPress, espresso, milk drinks — take your pick. Jasmine and red mace spice in a Robusta? Yes, really. This is coffee for brewers who love a plot twist. Swap your usual cup for Sweet Illusions and prepare to rethink what Robusta is capable of.

coffee_name: The Nut Job – Mooleh Manay 120H Carbonic Naturals – Fine Robusta
tasting_notes: Standout nut-driven profile with delicate floral aromatics; cinnamon, nerium, pecan, and roasted jackfruit seed
description_raw: The Nut Job marks South India Coffee Company’s latest Robusta experiment — an extended 120-hour carbonic macerated natural that delivers a standout nut-driven profile with delicate floral aromatics. This lot demonstrates how far Robusta has evolved, offering depth and nuance once considered out of reach for the species. We continue to seek coffees that merge Robusta’s signature richness with the complexity unlocked through thoughtful fermentation, and this release stands as compelling proof of what the future of Robusta can be.

tasting_notes: Tangy berry sweetness and smooth, nutty finish; apricot, black currant, blackberries, and hazelnut
description_raw: Currant Affairs is our vibrant, berry-forward showcase lot from Karadykan Estate in Chikmagalur, crafted in partnership with our long-standing producer partners at Sangameshwar Coffee Estates. Fermented with unrefined natural sugars, this coffee bursts with tangy berry sweetness and a smooth, nutty finish—an expressive cup that shines equally in espresso and manual brews. Our omni roast leans toward a balanced medium, unlocking layered sweetness and complexity while softening any sharp edges for a clean, easy-drinking experience. We’re proud to continue our collaboration with Sangameshwar, a producer that consistently pushes quality forward while championing community well-being. Their commitment spans from improved processing innovations to meaningful investments in worker housing, education, and sustainable initiatives like hydroelectric energy for pulping. Currant Affairs celebrates this shared vision—exceptional coffee rooted in people, progress, and experimentation.

tasting_notes: Dried fruit sweetness, chocolate depth, and subtle florals in the aroma; dark chocolate, grapefruit, honeysuckle, and raisins
description_raw: We’re excited to welcome a new producer to the Naivo family: Manohar Shetty of Indravathi Estate. This lot was processed in collaboration with South India Coffee Company and profiled as a versatile espresso roast that performs reliably across both black and milk beverages. The cup brings together dried fruit sweetness, chocolate depth and a thread of subtle florals in the aroma, creating a balanced and confident flavour structure. It is designed to be a dependable everyday coffee with consistency across brews. The profile shines through immersion methods such as Aeropress and French Press, where it delivers bold flavour and a satisfying mouthfeel. It also pairs exceptionally well with the South Indian Filter, producing an aromatic, rich and familiar style of filter coffee.

tasting_notes: Grape and berry notes with jammy texture, crisp acidity, and creamy full body; mulberry, red grapes, strawberry, and clove
description_raw: Berry Dawn from Baarbara Estate is dual-fermented natural sun-dried lot, showcasing a spectrum of grape and berry notes shaped through meticulous two-stage fermentation. This process enhances mouthfeel while preserving clarity and complexity, reflecting Sreeraksha’s innovative approach to processing. Our omni roast highlights the coffee’s versatility, delivering a creamy, full-bodied espresso and equally refined, sweet pour-overs. With its jammy texture, crisp acidity, and layered fruit expression, Berry Dawn captures both precision in processing and complexity in the cup.

tasting_notes: Sweet, tangy, and lively tropical notes with blood orange, dried mango, mosambi, and pineapple from pineapple co-fermentation
description_raw: The pineapple-fermented Arabica from Baarbara Estate has been one of our bestsellers over the past two years. This year’s harvest takes on a new identity in our showcase collection as Tropical Splash, with a roast profile fine-tuned to push the boundaries of espresso brewing. Nestled in the lush Bababudangiri Range, Baarbara Estate, operated by fourth-generation producer Sreeraksha Pournesh, has made groundbreaking advances in post-harvest processing. Playful yet precise fermentation with pineapple introduces a vivid new layer of sweetness to the coffee. The result is a cup that captures the essence of the tropics — sweet, tangy, and lively. Crafted for brewers who seek character in every sip, Tropical Splash delivers a lipsmacking espresso and a sweet, refreshing cold brew, offering a memorable journey into the possibilities of coffee co-fermentation with fruit.

tasting_notes: Clean, bold cup with dark chocolate, malt, and prune flavors
description_raw: This washed lot comes from Kolli Berri Estate in Mudigere, 30 km from Chikmagalur, a women-led enterprise run by Pranathi Shetty. The cup is clean, uniform, and marked by bold flavors that cut through with clarity and balance. Designed for everyday drinking, it carries both strength and refinement—dependable yet distinctive.

coffee_name: Dragon Jam – Kolli Berri Anaerobic Naturals
tasting_notes: Explosion of funk and fruit with sweetness, layered fruit depth, and creamy mouthfeel; Barbados cherry, dragon fruit, jamun, and mixed fruit jam
description_raw: Dragon Jam from Kolli Berri Estate is the first showcase coffee of the 2025 harvest—an explosion of funk and fruit. Run by Pranathi Shetty, Kolli Berri is a women-led enterprise in Mudigere, 30 km from Chikmagalur. This lot brims with sweetness, layered fruit depth, and a creamy mouthfeel. Roasted to a medium profile, it thrives across espresso, pourovers, and cold brew.

tasting_notes: Refined, complex, and bold with dried mango, jackfruit, nutmeg, and sweet cream; layered flavour built through mosto culture fermentation
description_raw: Ashok Patre bends tradition by bringing an Arabica mosto culture into Robusta processing—engineering a cup that is refined, complex, and confident enough to rival any specialty Arabica. Mosto is the liquid drawn from fermented coffee cherries, packed with wild yeasts, bacteria, and enzymes that act as a catalyst to build layered flavor during fermentation. At Naivo, we have long prophesied the untapped potential of Robusta and the infinite flavors it holds to expand the coffee universe. This lot is that prophecy made real—bold, articulate, and ready to tell you a striking new story of flavor.

tasting_notes: Fruit-forward, syrupy, and sweet with immaculate clarity; figs, pineapple jam, prunes, and starfruit
description_raw: Some coffees born from experimental fermentations have earned the label “dirty” from traditionalists, pushing producers to fine-tune processes that balance sweetness with clarity. This lot from the Ratnagiri Vault shows how far Ashok Patre has taken that challenge. His work with microbial cultures, controlled fermentations, and precise drying has steadily shifted Ratnagiri’s output—from wild, funky, boundary-pushing cups to more nuanced, elegant expressions that remain just as memorable. Here, sweetness is immaculate and clarity uncompromised. Every note is sharply defined, every layer distinct. Built for espresso, it offers a fruit-forward cup—syrupy, sweet, but balanced. Its clarity translates seamlessly into refined pourovers, while its richness anchors deeply satisfying cold brews.

tasting_notes: Bold, balanced, and sweet with citrus blossom, licorice, roasted pecan, and tea rose
description_raw: It feels almost ironic to roast a straight-up double washed coffee from Ratnagiri Estate—a farm celebrated for wild experiments and pushing boundaries. But that’s exactly why this lot stands out. It’s proof that when Ashok Patre turns his focus to simpler aspects of coffee processing, the execution is still flawless. No noise, no gimmicks—just a coffee that’s bold, balanced, sweet, and built to be slurped. This lot isn’t here to impress once—it’s here to earn a permanent place in your daily brewing routine.

tasting_notes: Sweet, syrupy, and saturated with layers of ripe fruit; bing cherries, blackberries, green apple, and pink guava
description_raw: Ashok Patre has invested heavily in precision processing, going as far as building a dedicated dark room to dry coffee in complete isolation from external elements. By removing sunlight and stabilizing airflow, the dark room slows drying, protects fragile compounds, and deepens flavor development. This lot begins with thermal-shocked, LAB-inoculated cherry fermentation—an approach that heightens control and pushes fruit expression into bold territory. The result is a cup of remarkable complexity: sweet, syrupy, and saturated with layers of ripe fruit. As espresso, it delivers blockbuster intensity—creamy, fruit-forward, and lingering. It shines equally in immersion brews like French Press and Aeropress, while its vivid fruit character and dense sweetness make it a prime candidate for inventive cold brew experiments.

tasting_notes: Floral aromatics, tangy-sweet acidity, and a clean tea-like finish; black tea, tamarind, and wood apple
description_raw: This AA washed lot comes from Mondul Estate, a 211-hectare farm located in northern Tanzania’s Arusha region — within Maasai territory and managed under the Burka Estates group. Established in 1931 and acquired in 2007, Mondul is known for its structured operations, high elevation, and consistent processing standards. Washed and dried on raised beds using spring water from the estate, this lot reflects the hallmarks of Tanzanian coffees: floral aromatics, tangy-sweet acidity, and a clean, tea-like finish. Our filter roast is intentionally light, with just enough development to preserve origin clarity while unlocking balanced sweetness. Mondul represents a model of controlled production — from farm management to cup profile — delivering a coffee that’s precise, articulate, and rooted in process.

tasting_notes: Orange zest, simple syrup sweetness, and walnut
description_raw: Our first lot from Kerala is a washed Arabica from Seethargundu Estate that belongs to the POABS Organic Estates group. Nestled in the cool, picturesque hills of Nelliyampathy, this estate is located within the majestic Sahyadri mountain range, renowned for its rich biodiversity and recognized as one of the world’s biodiversity hotspots by the IUCN. The Nelliyampathy region, just 65 km from Palakkad, boasts fertile valleys lined with tea, coffee, cardamom, and other plantations that thrive in its ideal climate, characterized by annual rainfall of around 4000 mm and temperatures ranging from 14°C to 30°C. Seethargundu Estate stands out not only for its high-quality coffee but also for its breathtaking views of the valley, offering visitors an unforgettable panorama.

tasting_notes: Rich sweetness intertwined with distinct spice notes, rich body, mild acidity; chocolate brownie, cumin, and vanilla
description_raw: Here’s another treat for Robusta enthusiasts from innovative producer Ashish Rao, showcasing the endless potential of Robustas from the Coorg region. This is a versatile coffee that adapts to diverse brewing styles, whether it’s a bold French Press brew, a refined pour-over, a quick brew through the Aeropress, or a simple brew with a Channi if you’ve got no fancy equipment at home. Our tailored roast profile for honey sundried Robustas brings out the sweetness in this coffee intertwined with distinct spice notes. The rich body and mild acidity are evident making this a delight for lovers of robust, punchy coffees without overwhelming bitterness in the aftertaste.

tasting_notes: Balanced fruit bomb with passion fruit, pistachio, and tutti frutti
description_raw: Our lot of naturals from Dunduga Estate is a balanced fruit bomb that works well with a diverse range of brewing methods including pourovers, aeropress, espresso and cold brew. This is our first year of collaboration with D S Raghu and his wife Shanthala who come from a long and rich heritage of coffee production at Dunduga Estate in the Mudigere region. Established in the 1950s, coffee at Dunduga grows alongside Pepper, Areca and jungle trees including Jackfruit, Mahogany, Rose wood, Mango, Red and White Cedar.

tasting_notes: Rich, strong, and smoky profile reminiscent of Turkish tobacco, with black pepper and malt
description_raw: This washed coffee from Dunduga Estate boasts of a rich, strong, and smoky profile reminiscent of Turkish Tobacco. This is our first collaboration with D S Raghu and his wife Shanthala who come from a long and rich heritage of coffee production at Dunduga Estate in the Mudigere region. Established in the 1950s, coffee at Dunduga grows alongside Pepper, Areca and jungle trees including Jackfruit, Mahogany, Rose wood, Mango, Red and White Cedar.

tasting_notes: Cardamom, dark chocolate, and nutmeg
description_raw: We’ve made significant progress in our exploration of Fine Robustas, aiming to showcase the high quality of Robusta coffee produced in India. Most Indian Robusta is exported to Europe and Australia, while much of what stays within the country is utilized by instant coffee manufacturers and roasters focusing on mass-produced commercial blends for espresso and South Indian filter coffee. With revolutionary advancements in farming, fermentation, and post-harvest processing, our producers are generating considerable excitement in the Robusta space.

tasting_notes: Caramel, milk chocolate, and sweet cream with perfect harmony of flavour and aroma
description_raw: In collaboration with the skilled producers at Harley Estate, nestled in the picturesque region of Sakleshpur, renowned for its rich volcanic soil and unique microclimate, we proudly present India’s famed Robusta Kaapi Royale. This exquisite coffee showcases a perfect harmony of flavor and aroma. Meticulously handpicked at peak ripeness, only the finest Robusta beans are selected, guaranteeing an unparalleled level of quality and consistency.

tasting_notes: Remarkably sweet but balanced; apricot, cane sugar, and honey
description_raw: As we navigate the expansive and intricate landscape of specialty coffees, characterized by advanced fermentation techniques, we find a deep appreciation for the traditional elements of washed coffee lots. Discovering a washed lot with distinctive characteristics and remarkably sweet but balanced flavors often influences our choice for a daily coffee staple. Our association with Unakki Estate commenced through ongoing discussions with Utsav Gowda, an enthusiastic young farmer passionately managing the operations at the estate. An aspiring lawyer balancing his academic pursuits with the challenges of safeguarding his coffee crop from unpredictable rains, Utsav embodies the promising future of Indian coffee.

tasting_notes: Rich and complex profile with dried berries, lychee, and stone fruit; curated for espresso
description_raw: Unakki Dark Honey is a testament to our enduring partnership with producer Utsav Gowda of Unakki Estate. Following the success of Unakki’s washed lot, a bestseller celebrated by our customers for its clean, consistent, and classic flavor profile, Utsav continues to refine his processing techniques. This year, he presents us with a remarkable Dark Honey, meticulously curated for optimal performance in espresso. With its rich and complex profile, this coffee exemplifies Utsav’s dedication to innovation and quality. This release reinforces our commitment to fostering a long-term relationship with Unakki Estate, ensuring a future of extraordinary coffees for our community.

tasting_notes: Clean and bright acidity with nutty and tangy notes and a very subtle floral aroma; almonds and gooseberries
description_raw: The Chandragiri varietal when put through the washed process is characterized by clean and bright acidity complemented by nutty and tangy notes and a very subtle floral aroma. This coffee comes from one of our earliest producer partners – Balanoor Plantations – who are pioneers of washed coffees in India and have been exporting some of the finest Arabicas to specialty markets in Europe for several decades.

tasting_notes: Dark chocolate notes harmoniously dancing with nutty aromas and a rounded cedar finish
description_raw: The first phrase that graced the lips of our Q-Grader when she analyzed this coffee was – “Bold and Beautiful.” By pushing this roast into medium dark territory, we get a lovely plethora of dark chocolate notes harmoniously dancing with nutty aromas and a rounded cedar finish. It is ideal for espresso brewing but is sure to be a favourite for Moka Pot enthusiasts and French Press fanatics who love a bold cup with a classic taste profile.

tasting_notes: Distinct, complex wild character with clove, jackfruit, and nutmeg
description_raw: Our first lot from BEWILD Coffee is an anoxic-fermented Fine Robusta from Poomaale Estate. This unique and complex wild-harvested canephora coffee embodies the essence of its origin. It is a testament to nature’s resilience and the power of regenerative agriculture. BEWILD have worked closely with a team of growers, roasters, and brewers to cultivate this coffee in a sustainable and ethical way, embracing the principles of permaculture and biodiversity conservation. The result is a distinct coffee experience that celebrates the wildness of the forest and the magic of nature.

tasting_notes: Mandarin brightness and red apple freshness with clean, lifted quality; cacao nibs, cashew butter, chocolate muffin, and pepper
origin: Through Selective Harvesting And Consistent Farm
description_raw: On the steep, rocky slopes of Degu Gasarapalli in Hukumpeta, Oranaini Apparao cultivates coffee at 1,170 metres, where elevation, soil and shade come together to shape a slower, more deliberate harvest. Under a canopy of silver oak trees, the cherries ripen gradually, allowing sugars to develop with care — resulting in a coffee that carries both structure and clarity. Through selective harvesting and consistent farm practices, the focus has shifted towards quality, where each lot reflects not just the land, but the discipline behind it. For this release, the cherries are naturally processed, dried with the fruit intact to enhance sweetness and build a rounded body. This process, combined with the density developed at higher elevation, creates a cup that feels full yet never heavy — a balance that becomes especially important in warmer months. In the cup, mandarin brightness and red apple freshness bring a clean, lifted quality that keeps the coffee vibrant and easy to return to, while a base of chocolate and cocoa adds depth without overwhelming the palate. A gentle cashew-like creaminess softens the texture, and a subtle finish of dark greens and pepper adds quiet complexity. It is this balance — between brightness and depth, sweetness and structure — that makes the coffee naturally suited to the season. Whether brewed as a crisp pour-over or a smooth cold brew, it remains composed, expressive and refreshing, reflecting how terroir, process and craft come together in a cup designed for summer.

tasting_notes: Bright notes of red apple and watermelon, layered with cocoa nib richness and honeyed sweetness, finishing with white floral elegance
origin: S Of Araku Coffee’S First Flagship Store At Indira
description_raw: Introducing the Anniversary Edit — a rare blend of three single-plot coffees, created to celebrate five years of ARAKU Coffee’s first flagship store at Indiranagar, Bengaluru and the farmers who made it possible. Sourced from Gondi Rapa, Gondivalasa and Doravalasa, this blend brings together one natural and two washed coffees, grown at elevations between 3,691 and 3,967 ft. Cultivated under silver oak and native forest shade, each plot follows regenerative farming practices that preserve both biodiversity and flavour integrity. In the cup, expect a refined and expressive profile — bright notes of red apple and watermelon , layered with cocoa nib richness and honeyed sweetness , finishing with a clean, lingering white floral elegance .

coffee_name: Taste the Terroir: Coffee Sampler Pack
origin: Ects Araku’S Commitment To Traceability, Craft, An
description_raw: In specialty coffee, flavour begins long before roasting — it begins in the land. This Terroir Coffee Sample Pack is an invitation to explore how altitude, soil, micro-climate, and careful cultivation shape what you taste in the cup. Each coffee in this set comes from a distinct growing environment, allowing you to experience how terroir expresses itself through sweetness, acidity, body, and aroma. Curated for both discovery and comparison, this set lets you brew the coffees side by side, slow down, and understand your own preferences — before choosing a larger pouch. The collection includes four 100% Arabica coffees: Selection – Medium Dark Roast Rounded and balanced, with deeper body and comforting sweetness Signature – Medium Roast Smooth and versatile, designed for everyday clarity and balance Grand Reserve – Medium Roast Layered and refined, highlighting complexity and structure Micro Climate – Medium Roast Nuanced and expressive, shaped by specific micro-regional conditions Roasted to highlight origin character rather than bitterness, each coffee reflects ARAKU’s commitment to traceability, craft, and flavour clarity. Ideal for mindful brewing, thoughtful gifting, or anyone looking to deepen their understanding of specialty coffee — one cup at a time.

It is roasted till moderately brown which emphasizes on its rich and luxurious flavor. It is one of the strong ones with prolonged after taste.

tasting_notes: Raspberry, White Chocolate and Fresh Stone Fruit.
description_raw: Elevation: 1150 MASL Variety: S795 Processing: Naturals Fermentation: Anaerobic Naturals Roast: Light Producers: Pranathi Shetty Tasting notes: Raspberry, White Chocolate & Fresh Stone Fruit Pranathi from Koliberri Coffee runs an all-women farm called Kolibyle Estate in Mudigere village, Chikmagalur, where she grows and processes some truly incredible coffees. The farm has been in Pranathi’s family for seventy years, and over the last few years she has focused on producing exceptional naturally processed coffees using minimal intervention. At Koliberri, the focus has been on transforming agricultural practices and improving soil quality using organic and sustainable methods. This has led to healthier coffee plants and some seriously yummy coffees for us At BCR, we tend to enjoy naturally processed coffees without a lot of additional intervention—which, unfortunately for us, has become pretty hard to come by. Thankfully, we inevitably find a few coffees every year that pass our bar of being clean and sweet, sans the funk. This anaerobic natural, for us, is one of the best expressions of a simple, clean, sweet natural. Ripe cherries were picked and meticulously sorted, then fermented anaerobically for 96 hours before being dried on raised beds for 28 days. This was the first coffee we sampled and the first coffee we purchased from the previous harvest—and it’s the coffee we’ve gone back to again and again in the roastery. A light roast with notes of raspberry, white chocolate, and fresh stone fruits, this coffee is super bright with a very clean, sharp acidity. It’s beautifully balanced by sweet stone fruits and a soft milk chocolate finish that creates a lovely, silky mouthfeel. Give around 10 days before you start brewing this one!

tasting_notes: Raisins, Papaya, Citrus Fruits and Floral.
description_raw: Elevation: 1650MASL Variety: SLN9 Processing: Washed Fermentation: Wild Mandarin Co-ferment Roast: Light Producers: Mrs Hamsini, Shriya & Mr. S Appadurai Tasting notes: Raisins, Papaya, Citrus Fruits, Floral At BCR, we’ve always been chasing great-tasting washed coffees and have tried our best to stay away from intense co-ferments. This coffee, despite being a co-ferment, manages to remain super clean and vibrant, with an added layer of complexity coming from the fermentation. Having spoken to Hamsini about this, she claims that this co-ferment is a process they've been doing for a while and through the years they have understood how to make this taste super clean As an Indian roaster, it’s rare to work with a coffee of this elevation and density, which made it a bit of a challenge to get right. Through multiple test batches, we realised this coffee needed much more heat and more development than we would usually give a supposed light roast. Our final Season Ticket profile for this coffee was a high-heat, short roast up to first crack, followed by a slower development to ensure the bean was cooked properly from the inside. The final cup is bright, clean, and juicy, with notes of black raisins, citrus fruits, ripe papaya, and orange blossom florals. For us, this coffee has often been a palate cleanser between some of the heavier naturals we’ve had this year. Its floral notes and juicy body really remind us of a great Kenyan coffee. And the fact that this comes from India makes us very happy.

tasting_notes: Tropical Fruits, Milk Chocolate, and Hazelnuts.
description_raw: Elevation: 1200 MASL Variety: S795 Processing: Yellow Honey Fermentation: Anaerobic Fermentation before pulping Roast: Medium Light Producers: Sharan and Ishwar Gowda Tasting notes: Tropical Fruits, Milk Chocolate, and Hazelnuts Sharan and Ishwar Gowda have been producing some truly stellar coffees over the last few years, and each year we're just blown away by how they keep making their coffees taste better. Is it more data, more knowledge, better infrastructure, just more experience? We're not sure, and honestly, as long as they're producing coffees like these we're just happy that we get to have them with us. Their honey processed lots have been some of our favourites over the last few years, and this year their Yellow honey went through an Anaerobic Fermentation before pulping won our hearts again. With notes of fresh and bright tropical fruits, Milk Chocolate, and Hazelnuts, this yellow honey is balanced, with a rich chocolaty finish despite the lighter roast. The coffee is a real joy to brew and is quite forgiving as well. We hope you enjoy this as much as we do. Give around 12 days before you start brewing this one!

tasting_notes: Mulberries, Candied Nuts and Milk Chocolate.
description_raw: Elevation: 1150 MASL Variety: SLN9 Processing: Naturals Fermentation: Osmotic Naturals Roast: Light Producers: Pratheek Kumar Tasting notes: Mulberries, Candied Nuts, Milk Chocolate Give around 10 days before you start brewing this one!

tasting_notes: Stone Fruit, Cacao and Floral.
description_raw: Elevation: 1150MASL Variety: Chandragiri Processing: Naturals Fermentation: Anaerobic Roast: Light Producers: Kelachandra Coffee Works Tasting notes: Stone Fruit, Cacao, Floral Kelachandra coffee have been stepping up in their speciality coffee offerings year on year, and this year some of their lots were just super. This Chandragiri Anaerobic Naturals was a great example a well processed anaerobic Naturals. Being a relatively lower in elevation, the team has to work very hard, and has to be dilligent in the fermentation and the drying to ensure that the coffee tasted sweet, bright and complex, just the way we like them. This anaerobic Naturals took the ripest cherries, fermented them in steel tanks for 48 hours before they were dried over 24 days on raised beds. Over the last two years, we have really enjoyed Chandragiris, and some of our favourite coffees from the the last two years have been Chandragiris. This Chandragiri has again been one of the stand out coffees for this year, and we're quite glad that a variety that's uniquely Indian keep cropping up in our favourite coffees year after year. We feel that Chandragiris have a naturally high sweetness compared to some other varieties especially as light roasts, and this coffee lives up to our expectations. We get a subtle fruity cup from this coffee with notes of Stone Fruit, Cacao, and a hint of floral aromas Give around 8-10 days before you start brewing this one!

tasting_notes: Pineapple, Citrus Fruits and Cocoa.
description_raw: Elevation: 1150 MASL Variety: Chandragiri Processing: Naturals Fermentation: Anaerobic Yeast in a Bio-Reactor Roast: Light Producers: Sharan and Ishwar Gowda Tasting notes: Pineapple, Citrus Fruits, Cocoa Sharan and Ishwar Gowda have been producing some truly stellar coffees over the last few years, and each year we're just blown away by how they keep making their coffees taste better. Is it more data, more knowledge, better infrastructure, just more experience? We're not sure, and honestly, as long as they're producing coffees like these, we're just happy that we get to have them with us. Fermentation in coffee has blown up in the last few years. Bio Reactors are closed tanks designed for anaerobic or low oxygen fermentations. They allow you to control variables such as temperature, pH, time, pressure and allow inoculation with yeasts and other microbes. Using a bio-reactor, Sharan and his team were able to produce some great coffees this year, but what's more important is that through this they'll be able to consistently replicate these processes year on year. For this Naturals, Chandragiri cherries were picked ripe, cleaned, give a float test and were put in the bio-reactor to ferment for 36 hours. The cherries were inoculated with yeast during the fermentation. They were then dried over 26 days with tremendous attention to the temperature and humidity around the batch. The Result is fruit forward, but super complex coffee with notes of Pineapple, Bright Citrus Fruits, and a cocoa finish. Give around 10 days before you start brewing this one!

tasting_notes: Peaches, White Chocolate and Butterscotch.
description_raw: Elevation: 1150 MASL Variety: Chandragiri Processing: Washed Fermentation: Anaerobic Yeast Roast: Light Producers: Sharan and Ishwar Gowda Tasting notes: Peaches, White Chocolate, Butterscotch Sharan and Ishwar Gowda have been producing some truly stellar coffees over the last few years, and each year we're just blown away by how they keep making their coffees taste better. Is it more data, more knowledge, better infrastructure, just more experience? We're not sure, and honestly, as long as they're producing coffees like these we're just happy that we get to have them with us. This washed process went through an Anaerobic yeast Fermentation before pulping, and then the coffee was washed thoroughly to remove the mucilage. With notes of Peaches, White Chocolate and rich butterscotch, this is a unique coffee that is sweet, complex and with a rounded acidity, but clear flavours in the cup. The coffee is a real joy to brew and is quite forgiving as well. We hope you enjoy this as much as we do. Give around 12 days before you start brewing this one!

tasting_notes: Plum, Milk Chocolate and Fresh Tropical Fruits.
description_raw: Elevation: 1150MASL Variety: Chandragiri Processing: Yellow Honey Fermentation: Sugarcane Co-Ferment Roast: Light Producers: Kelachandra Coffee Works Tasting notes: Plum, Milk Chocolate, Fresh Tropical Fruits This year, the team at Kelachandra stepped up their efforts and from their Jensury Estate they gave us a beautiful Sugarcane fermented honey process Chandragiri that stood out most of the other coffees we tasted with regards to just how clean and fresh the coffee tasted. Being a relatively lower in elevation, the team had to work very hard, and had to be dilligent in the fermentation and the drying to ensure that the coffee tasted sweet, bright and complex, just the way we like them. We first tasted this coffee at the IICF at their stall and some other roaster had booked the entire lot, but on first sip we knew this coffee deserved to be brewed by the best brewers in the country so Shivansh sweet talked his way into getting us the entire lot! Over the last two years, we have really enjoyed Chandragiris, and some of our favourite coffees from the the last two years have been Chandragiris. This Chandragiri has again been one of the stand out coffees for this year, and we're quite glad that a variety that's uniquely Indian keep cropping up in our favourite coffees year after year. We feel that Chandragiris have a naturally high sweetness compared to some other varieties especially as light roasts, and this coffee lives up to our expectations. Ripe cherries were picked, sorted, cleaned and then pulped leaving a little bit of mucilage. They were then fermented for 24 hours in sugarcane pulp, which introduces extra sugars loads of fun microbial activity which has increased the overall sweetness, and the notes of tropical fruits in the cup. With our light roast, we feel we were able to bring out a lot of that inherent sweetness and notes of fresh tropical fruits. The lower elevation seems to have kept a balancing note of milk chocolate, which is complemented by a brig

tasting_notes: Blackberry Jam, Caramel and Cacao.
description_raw: Elevation: 1130 MASL Variety: SL9 Processing: Naturals Roast: Dark (Vienna Roast) Producers: Mr. D.M Purnesh, Chandini & Tapaswini Tasting notes: Blackberry Jam, Caramel & Cacao Harley Estate is one of India’s finest coffee plantations with a rich history of innovation, excellent processing and award-winning coffees galore. Run by Mr D.M Purnesh and his daughters Tapaswini and Chandini, they make use of state-of-the-art growing, and processing techniques along with some incredibly designed fermentations to produce some truly spectacular coffees. We've learnt that this incredible coffee tastes amazing as a super light roast and as a dark roast! Here's a Vienna Roast that retains the nuances and complexities of this amazing coffee. With notes of Cacao, sweet blackberry jam, and a caramel finish, this vienna roast is something special. This Vienna roast pairs very well with milk and milk alternatives, and tastes great black as an espresso, or even a dark roast pour over!

tasting_notes: Orange Marmalade, Dried Apricots and Dark Chocolate.
description_raw: Elevation: 1050 MASL Variety: Sachimore Processing: Naturals Fermentation: No specific Fermentation Design Roast: Light Producers: Hoysala Coffee Tasting notes: Orange Marmalade, Dried Apricots and Dark Chocolate The Hoysala Estate was started in the late 1800s is has been family-owned since the 1950's. This washed process lot comes from their farm located in Angadi village near Chikmagalur where the Hoysala Dynasty started in the 9th century. Sunil & Mohan and their families have taken Hoysala coffee to similar heights through their incredible knowledge and expertise in growing, and processing coffee. Working with them for the first time during this harvest, and trying some of their coffees really blew us away. Like other coffees at their farm, this naturally processed coffee is grown using regenerative farming practices, and no chemical fertilisers. This naturals Sachimore was one of our favourite naturally processed coffees from the previous year's harvest and features a jammy citrus note with the sweetness of dried apricots. With a medium-light roast, the coffee has developed a lovely stone fruit sweetness and a subtle orange acidity. This coffee works superbly as a filter and as an espresso, and pairs very well with small milk beverages like a cortado or macchiato. We hope you love this one as much as we have!

tasting_notes: Amla, Kinnow and Jaggery.
description_raw: Elevation: 1100 MASL Variety: S795 Processing: Red Honey Fermentation: 72 hours Anaerobic fermentation Roast: Light Producers: Sharan Gowda Tasting notes: Amla, Kinnow & Jaggery As many of you might know, Sharan was one of the first farmers we ever bought coffee from, in fact he was the first planter we ever met in real life! Back then Salawara Estate was just starting their speciality coffee journey, but in the last five years, they have undoubtedly emerged as one of the most outstanding coffee producers in the country. Their steadfast focus on agriculture and improving their infrastructure rather than content creation has yielded incredible results, and we're the ones reaping the benefits! This year we purchased four lots from them, but this Anaerobic Red Honey was by far our favourite when we cupped it, and with the final roast profile, it's one of the juiciest coffees we have tasted in a while! This S795 grown at 1100 MASL was the last batch of coffee that was processed last year, and the slow maturation, with a higher mucilage content made this the perfect bunch for an Anerobic Red Honey Process. The Cherries were pulped lightly, leaving a lot of the mucilage and were then fermented Anaerobically for 72 hours before they were slow dried for 22 days. The cherries and the process produced a very fruit forward cup, high in sweetness and acidity. To accentuate this, we roasted this super light, and the result is a super juicy coffee with notes of Blackberries, Orange Zest and a lingering sugarcane sweetness.

tasting_notes: Plum, Bakers Chocolate and Orange.
description_raw: Elevation: 1000 MASL Variety: S795 & Catimor Processing: Naturals Fermentation: 24 hour in fruit Aerobic Fermentation, slow dried for 28 days Roast: Light Producers: Nisha & Kurian Thomas Tasting notes: Plum, Bakers Chocolate & Orange Anai Kadu takes its name of the Elepahants (Kadu) that frequent their estate. Located in Maldare in Coorg, Nisha and Kurian left their corporate lives in Bangalore and moved to their 50 acre coffee farm during the pandemic and started their journey of producing speciality coffee. Anai Kadu came to the fore a couple of years back when they did some incredible nano lots of their arabicas and robustas. Over the last few years,they established themselves as one of the more experimental and promising coffee farms in Coorg. From their gorgeous packing and hand-drawn illustrations that are sent with the green coffee samples to the meticulous farming and processing, they are one of the farms that we look forward to working with every year! Like last year, we picked up their Naturals, called the Elephant's Trail, but this time around it's an Aerobic Naturals which we really enjoyed and felt that it was a worthy repeat season ticket offering! The Aerobic fermentation done with this S795 has yielded a super sweet and a fruity cup, without any booziness. We always enjoy sweet, and clean naturals, and this one is just that. Compared to some of the other coffees we've put out this year, this one is heavier on the mouthfeel and has a lovely chocolate finish. To enhance the syrupy mouthfeel, we roasted this a bit slower but kept is slight still. The coffee has a sweet plum flavour, with notes of citrus and syrupy chocolate finish.

tasting_notes: Super chocolate and sweet notes from the Robusta naturals.
description_raw: Elevation: 3300 ft. – 4500ft. Varietal: Arabica S795, Robusta C x R Planters: Sharan Gowda, and Vinay Venugopal Processing: Washed Arabica and Naturals Robusta Roast: Dark This blend features the lovely washed arabica from the Salawara Estate, and the natural processed robusta from the Kottaram Estate in Wayanad, Kerala. This is the first time we've purchased coffee from Kerala, and thanks the incredible work and efforts done by Vinay, his family and his team at the estate, we were blown away by the flavour profile of the robusta naturals. Thanks to the super chocolate and sweet notes of the Rubusta we were able to roast this a bit a darker than usual, and still not get off and bitter notes in the cup. Kid Dynamite is a perfect for those who like a punch in their coffees, and it goes really well with milk based beverages, be it through espresso or through a south Indian Filter.

tasting_notes: Coffee Blossom, Stone Fruit and Oranges.
description_raw: Elevation: 1050 MASL Variety: Sachimore Processing: Washed Fermentation: In fruit fermentation before pulping Roast: Light Producers: Hoysala Coffee Tasting notes: Coffee Blossom, Stone Fruit, & Oranges The Hoysala Estate was started in the late 1800s is has been family-owned since the 1950's. This washed process lot comes from their farm located in Angadi village near Chikmagalur where the Hoysala Dynasty started in the 9th century. Sunil & Mohan and their families have taken Hoysala coffee to similar heights through their incredible knowledge and expertise in growing, and processing coffee. Working with them for the first time during this harvest, and trying some of their coffees really blew us away. Like other coffees at their farm, this washed coffee is grown using regenerative farming practices, and no chemical fertilisers. This fermented-washed Sachimore was one of our favourite washed coffees from the previous year's harvest and features a delicate floral note reminiscent of coffee blossom. With a medium-light roast, the coffee has developed a lovely stone fruit sweetness and a subtle orange acidity. This coffee works superbly as a filter and as an espresso, and pairs very well with small milk beverages like a cortado or macchiato. We hope you love this one as much as we have!

coffee_name: Venkids Valley Estate - The Red Honey
tasting_notes: Mango, Hibiscus and Butterscotch.
description_raw: Elevation: 1000 MASL Variety: Catuai Processing: Red Honey Roast: Light Producers: Mr Pavan Nanjappa Tasting notes: Mango, Hibiscus and Butterscotch We along with so many others have swooned for two seasons over the incredible Yellow Honey that Pavan produces every year. This year, the team at the Venkids Valley Estate decided to take their Catuai a step further, from a Yellow Honey process to a Red Honey process and take our word for it, this is an exceptional coffee. With the new process, the coffee has become slightly sweeter with more intense flavours and a richer mouthfeel. We have roasted this pretty lightly to let the coffee, and the process really shine through and take the centre stage. With sweet notes of Mango, rich butterscotch and delicate hints of Hibiscus this coffee makes an incredible filter coffee that we're sure you'll absolutely enjoy!
coffee_name_clean: Venkids Valley Estate - The Red Honey

tasting_notes: Caramel, Bakers Chocolate, Berries and Vanilla.
origin: Rg & Chikmagalur Elevation: 1100 - 1250 Masl Varietal: S
description_raw: Estates: Venkids Valley Estate & Hoysala Estate Region: Coorg & Chikmagalur Elevation: 1100 - 1250 MASL Varietal: SLN6, Chandragiri Processing: Washed & Naturals Roast: Medium Light Tasting notes: Caramel, Bakers Chocolate, Berries and Vanilla Meera - A fearless espresso blend that breaks the conventions of what an espresso blend should be! Meera is our Medium-light roast espresso blend with notes of strawberries, baker’s chocolate, vanilla and decadent caramel. This is our tribute to one of India's most celebrated mystic poets, Meera Bai. Meera features two incredible coffees, our staple washed arabica from Coorg’s favourite plantation, the Venkids Valley Estate, and a stunning “Natural Naturals“ from the Krishnagiri Estate, located in some of the highest elevations of Chikmagalur. What do we get when we blend a clean bright washed and a super sweet, jammy Natural Naturals? A yummy, sweet, super complex, rich espresso, which holds its own in milk beverages as well! It’s fair to say that this blend has had a pretty long development phase, but you know that we don’t take our blends lightly, and launch them only when we’re really happy with it, and right now we’re delighted with this and are finally ready to introduce you to “Meera”. Recommended recipe: Dose : Being a lighter roast, we would recommend dosing one-half a gram lesser than what you would dose for a medium/medium dark roast coffee Grind Size: Grind a step or two finer than what you would normally for a medium roast Yield: We recommend a yield of 2.5 times the dose of the dry coffee. For eg: Dose: 20 grams; Yield: 50 grams Time: The lighter the roast, the more you need to extract to get good sweetness and complexity. We like shots between 28-33 seconds for a straight 9-bar approach for Meera. If you can pressure profile, we like to start with a 5-second pre-infusion at 2 bars, and then ramp up to 8 bars till we hit the desired yield, which usually takes around 45-50 seconds. tasting_notes: Rich milk chocolate, subtle citrus acidity and plum.
description_raw: Elevation: 3850 ft. Variety: Kents Processing: Washed Roast: Medium Tasting notes: Chocolate, Citrus Fruits, and Plum Over the last 3 years, we have received some delicious excellent coffees from the wonderful people at Balanoor Plantations. They have been producing some of the finest speciality coffee in the country for a number of years, and they have undoubtedly given us some of our favourite washed coffees. The Kents variety is found widely in Indian coffee, and the work that the team at Balanoor puts in really makes this delightful coffee. This is the third year we've had this coffee, and somehow despite all the challenges, it just keeps getting better! This medium roast has notes of rich milk chocolate, a subtle citrus acidity, and plum. This coffee is truly a delight, and is delicious black or with milk as a filter or an espresso! Yup, you heard it right: a coffee can be anything you want it to be!

tasting_notes: Citrus Fruits, Cherries and Nuts.
description_raw: Farm: Laks Farm, Pachalur Village Planter: Mr. H.R. Iyer Elevation: 4920 ft. Variety: Chandragiri and SL9 Processing: Washed Roast: Medium Tasting notes: Citrus Fruits, Cherries, and Nuts Originating from one of the highest growing regions in Tamil Nadu, these coffees are dense and have a beautiful aftertaste because of the high growing Region. The Laks farm is completely organic and devoid of any chemical pesticides and fertilisers. The coffees are intercropped with oranges, cardamom, pepper and banana. The beans of the highest brix are identified (colour coded bands are given to workers at the estate to pick the cherries). They are sorted for defects twice before using the penagos washer + pulper. Floats are removed and the coffee beans with little bit of mucilage are dried on raised beds. They are exposed to the morning sun for the first two days and then completely dried in shade for a period of 20-25 days. Mr. Iyer is without doubt one of the sweetest and most earnest people we have encountered in coffee and with passion and efforts of Viggnesh in processing, this coffee was one of the best washed coffees we tasted this year! This medium roast has sweet notes of Cherry, and Nuts with a mild Citrus Acidity, and works really well both black and with milk, as a filter or an an espresso!

tasting_notes: Sweet notes of Red Apple and Pomegranate juice with subtle acidity and a rich body.
description_raw: Elevation: 3600 ft. Varietal: SLN6 Processing: Washed Roast: Light Tasting notes: Malt, Red Apple, Pomegranate Juice For those who know, Pavan and Shilpa Nanjappa's magnificent coffee estate, The Venkids Valley Estate, goes by the name of “Papakuchi Coffee”. As we all know by now, they grow some super duper delicious Arabicas as well as Robustas that have received so much love from everyone who has had them over the last year. When we got this year’s washed Arabica and did our profiling process we realised that this coffee had somehow become sweeter and even more yummy than the year before, and to our sheer joy it really stood out as a light roast!! With sweet notes of Red Apple and Pomegranate juice, a subtle acidity, and a pretty rich body this light roast is a great addition filter coffee lover. The best part, this coffee will be available throughout the year, and if we have it our way, forever and ever!

tasting_notes: Mexican chocolate, Caramel and Orange Zest.
description_raw: Elevation: 3600 ft. Varietal: SLN6 Processing: Washed Roast: Medium Tasting notes: Mexican chocolate, Caramel, and Orange Zest A short, scenic drive from Madikeri, past a rivulet or two, leads you to the charming “Papakuchi Coffee” by Venkids Valley Estate, where you are welcomed by Pavan and his wife Shilpa. The estate spreads across 200 acres, and is divided into “Patte” or fields, named aptly by the workers. Imagine being able to spot the exact patch of land your coffee was grown on. Yes, that’s the level of traceability Pavan is able to achieve at this estate. This SLN6, grown in the “Kenjipatte” is roasted to slightly darker than a medium (some might even call it a medium) to really enhance the syrupy body and the notes of caramel which are offset by the a splash of orange zest. Pretty great for filters, great for espresso! Pick you grind and brew away!

tasting_notes: Caramel, milk chocolate and subtle hints of citrus.
description_raw: Tasting Notes: Caramel, milk chocolate, subtle hints of citrus Elevation: 3130 ft. Varietal: Processing: Washed Roast: Dark Spread across 400 acres in the fabled hills of Chikmaglur, the Salawara estate was started in 1880, and produces some delicious Arabicas and Robustas that have won various awards in India and abroad. This washed arabica grown at 3130 ft. tastes of the rich terroir of the estate, dotted with exotic herbs and spices that are grown alongside the coffee. The coffee is roasted darker than our medium to bring out more of the delicious milk chocolate

tasting_notes: Chocolate, Dark Caramel and hints of Citrus.
description_raw: Elevation: 3200-3400 ft. Varietal: SL6 & SL9 Planters: Pavan Nanjappa & Sharan Gowda Processing: Washed Roast: Medium Dark Tasting notes: Chocolate, Dark Caramel, and hints of Citrus Chocolate, Dark Caramel and hints of citrus, sounds to us like one of the magnificent trumpet solos of the one the only Louis Armstrong! For us, Louis Armstrong a.k.a. Satchmo is the epitome of balance, with a voice that can go from a deep, rich gravel to almost fragile falsettos. Every moment of every song is filled with gorgeous melody, depth and genius improvisations! “Satchmo” the blend, just like it’s muse, has pitch perfect sweetness, a deep body that swells like a crescendo, and a subtle “Vibratoesque” citrus acidity. A coffee that goes not toe to toe, but “Cheek to Cheek” with all accompaniments. The blend is on the darker side of a medium, and has the richness of chocolate and dark caramel, and a raspy acidity that can cut through whatever you throw at it, yes we’re looking at you milk and sugar. Satchmo makes the perfect espressos, moka pots, french presses, south indian filters, and what not, to get you a coffee that’ll make you see sit across and think “What a Wonderful World”

tasting_notes: Berries, almonds and spiced chocolate.
description_raw: Elevation: 3200-4250 ft. Varietal: SL6, Sln9, Sln5B Planters: Pavan Najappa and Navin Rajes Processing: Washed Roast: Medium dark Tasting notes: Berries, almonds, and spiced Chocolate The origin of this blend goes a fair way back to when Pavan (Venkids Valley Estate) and Navin (Moganad Estate) were schoolmates and were busy making plans for the world domination of Indian speciality coffee! Little did they know then, that the catalyst for this would be small roastery out of Chandigarh, of all the places who would put their two phenomenal washed arabicas together in a top secret ratio, name it after the one of the greatest painters of all time, which is also a word play on their names, and make it the most the delicious, versatile blend to have ever come out of the greater Chandigarh region! Pavan and Navin still remain very tight, and share flights, coffees, jokes, and the roasters they choose to work with! Thankfully, they both agreed to partner with us, which in turn enabled us to come up with this super tasty, bright like a Red Vineyard, over The Cafe Terrace at night, lit up by The Starry Night All stories aside our Vin Van Gogh is our answer to a coffee blend that does everything very very well! It makes a great fruity filter coffee, as well the perfect espresso to have as it is, or a lovely fluffy cappuccino! Pick the grind of your choice, and bask in the glory of Vin’s and Van’s artistry!

tasting_notes: Super tasty blend with notable acidity and sweetness from the Robusta.
origin: Medium Dark This Blend Features The Lovely Washed Arabica From The Moganad Estate
description_raw: Elevation: 3300 ft. – 4500ft. Varietal: Arabica S795, Robusta Planters: Navin Rajes, and Pavan Nanjappa Processing: Washed Arabica and Naturals Robusta Roast: Medium Dark This blend features the lovely washed arabica from the Moganad Estate, and the natural processed robusta from the Venkids Valley Estate. But beware, if you’re expecting a bitter, boring blend, this will let you down! Ro-Busta Rhymes is a super duper tasty blend that really brings the best out both species of the coffees, but what’s really interesting is that acidity and the sweetness in this blend comes a great deal from the Robusta! We recommend you try this blend black just to really get a feel of what the robusta brings to it!

tasting_notes: Bright fruit character with floral lift and fermentation-led complexity. Clean citrus brightness to jammy tropical sweetness.
description_raw: FRUIT & FLORAL DUO BRINGS TOGETHER TWO EXPERIMENTAL RATNAGIRI MICROLOTS — BUILT AROUND BRIGHT FRUIT CHARACTER, FLORAL LIFT, AND FERMENTATION-LED COMPLEXITY. BOTH COFFEES COME FROM THE SAME ESTATE, BUT DIFFER IN PROCESS, RESULTING IN CUPS THAT FEEL DISTINCT, EXPRESSIVE, AND FULL OF PERSONALITY. CRAFTED FOR THOSE WHO ENJOY CLEAN, VIBRANT, AND LAYERED PROFILES, THIS DUO EXPLORES THE INTERPLAY OF JUICY FRUIT NOTES AND DELICATE FLORALS — FROM CITRUS-LIKE BRIGHTNESS TO JAMMY, TROPICAL SWEETNESS. EACH CUP IS DESIGNED TO FEEL LIFTED, AROMATIC, AND EASY TO KEEP COMING BACK TO. YC CULTURE NATURALS IS BRIGHT AND REFINED — CLEAN, CITRUS-LED, AND TEA-LIKE WITH A SOFT FLORAL FINISH. YEAST CARBONIC NATURALS IS MORE INTENSE AND EXPRESSIVE — JUICY, FRUIT-FORWARD, WITH LAYERED SWEETNESS AND A FLORAL, LINGERING AFTERTASTE. TWO COFFEES. TWO EXPRESSIONS. ONE DUO BUILT AROUND FRUIT, FLORALS, AND CLARITY IN THE CUP. INFORMATION: SET NAME: FRUIT & FLORAL DUO Includes: YC CULTURE NATURALS and YEAST CARBONIC NATURALS Roast Level: LIGHT TO MEDIUM-LIGHT FLAVOUR INTENT: BRIGHT, JUICY, EXPRESSIVE Tasting Notes (Set Overview): CITRUS, BERRY, TROPICAL FRUIT, FLORAL, JAMMY SWEETNESS Best Brewed With: POUR OVER, AEROPRESS, FRENCH PRESS, MOKA POT Roaster’s Select Recipes: POUR OVER – 18G IN, 300ML WATER, BREW TIME: 2:30–3:00 MIN AEROPRESS – 17G COFFEE, 220ML WATER, INVERTED METHOD, 2 MIN STEEP + 30 SEC PRESS FRENCH PRESS - 30G COFFEE, 500ML WATER, BREW TIME: 4 MIN

tasting_notes: Jasmine and Orange Blossom florals, followed by soft Banana sweetness and Cascara-like fruit character, with a subtle Peppermint coolness in the finish.
description_raw: FROM THE ELEVATED, SHADE-GROWN LANDSCAPES OF RATNAGIRI ESTATE COMES A COFFEE SHAPED BY EXPERIMENTATION AND CAREFUL CULTIVATION. YC CULTURE NATURALS IS AN EXCLUSIVE MICROLOT, PRODUCED IN LIMITED QUANTITIES, WHERE CONTROLLED FERMENTATION AND PRECISION PROCESSING COME TOGETHER TO CREATE A DISTINCT AND EXPRESSIVE CUP. PROCESSED AS A CULTURE NATURAL, THIS LOT USES SELECTED YEAST CULTURES DURING FERMENTATION TO ENHANCE AROMATICS AND BUILD LAYERED FLAVOUR COMPLEXITY. THE RESULT IS A CUP THAT FEELS FLORAL, LIFTED, AND GENTLY FRUIT-FORWARD, WHILE MAINTAINING CLARITY AND STRUCTURE. IN THE CUP, EXPECT JASMINE AND ORANGE BLOSSOM FLORALS, FOLLOWED BY SOFT BANANA SWEETNESS AND CASCARA-LIKE FRUIT CHARACTER, WITH A SUBTLE PEPPERMINT COOLNESS IN THE FINISH. BALANCED, AROMATIC, AND DISTINCTIVE, THIS IS A COFFEE THAT UNFOLDS WITH EVERY SIP. THIS IS A COFFEE THAT REFLECTS RATNAGIRI’S APPROACH TO INNOVATION — EXPRESSIVE, EXPERIMENTAL, AND DEEPLY INTENTIONAL. Information: Estate: Ratnagiri Estate Region: BABABUDANGIRI, KARNATAKA Producer: Ashok Patre Harvest: November to February LOT: RT-YC-01/6 Process: YC Culture Naturals Roast Level: Light Tasting Notes: JASMINE, ORANGE BLOSSOM, BANANA, CASCARA, PEPPERMINT Best Brewed With: Espresso, Aeropress, Pour Over Roaster’s Select Recipes: Aeropress: 17g coffee, 220ml water, inverted method, Brew Time: 2 min steep + 30 sec press Pour Over: 18g coffee, 270ml water, Medium Grind, Brew Time: 2:30 to 2:45

tasting_notes: Three light-roasted coffees with lifted acidity, clean sweetness, and crisp defined finishes.
description_raw: THE LIGHT ROAST EDIT IS A CURATED SET OF THREE LIGHT-ROASTED COFFEES DESIGNED TO SHOW HOW DIFFERENT “LIGHT ROAST” CAN TASTE. EACH COFFEE IN THIS EDIT COMES FROM A DIFFERENT ORIGIN AND PROCESS, BUT THEY’RE ALL ROASTED WITH THE SAME INTENT — CLARITY, SWEETNESS, AND STRUCTURE. THIS SET IS MADE TO BE TASTED SIDE BY SIDE. ONE CUP LEANS CLEAN AND PRECISE, ONE FEELS ROUND AND SWEETER, AND ONE TURNS UP THE AROMATICS AND JUICY FRUIT. IT’S THE EASIEST WAY TO EXPERIENCE LIGHT ROAST RANGE — WITHOUT OVERTHINKING IT, JUST BY BREWING AND COMPARING. EXPECT LIFTED ACIDITY, CLEAN SWEETNESS, AND FINISHES THAT STAY CRISP AND DEFINED. BEST BREWED AS POUR-OVER OR AEROPRESS, AND ALSO BEAUTIFUL AS MODERN ESPRESSO IF YOU LIKE BRIGHT, EXPRESSIVE SHOTS. tasting_notes: Plum Cake, Lemon Verbena, Warm Spice, Strawberry and Cacao Nibs.
description_raw: FROM THE COOL, ELEVATED LANDSCAPE OF THE PULNEY HILLS IN TAMIL NADU COMES A COFFEE SHAPED BY CAREFUL HANDWORK, CONTROLLED FERMENTATION, AND TIME. THIS IS OUR FIRST COLLABORATION WITH THE AMMIKULAVI ESTATE, LOCATED NEAR KODAIKANAL AT AROUND 1400 MASL, WHERE SLOW CHERRY DEVELOPMENT AND COOL CLIMATES ALLOW FLAVOUR TO FORM WITH DEPTH AND STRUCTURE. THIS MICROL0T IS PRODUCED USING A 72-HOUR ANAEROBIC FERMENTATION, WHERE RIPE, HAND-PICKED CHERRIES ARE SEALED IN AIRTIGHT BARRELS TO DEVELOP SWEETNESS AND COMPLEXITY IN A CONTROLLED, OXYGEN-FREE ENVIRONMENT. FOLLOWING FERMENTATION, THE COFFEE IS WASHED, BRIEFLY SUN-DRIED, AND THEN SHADE-DRIED SLOWLY ON RAISED BEDS. A FINAL RESTING PERIOD ALLOWS THE FLAVOURS TO STABILISE AND INTEGRATE FULLY. IN THE CUP, THIS COFFEE IS LAYERED AND EXPRESSIVE, WITH NOTES OF PLUM CAKE, LEMON VERBENA, WARM SPICE, STRAWBERRY, AND CACAO NIBS. ROASTED MEDIUM-LIGHT, IT MAINTAINS CLARITY AND SWEETNESS WHILE OFFERING A ROUNDED BODY AND STRUCTURED FINISH. THIS IS A COFFEE THAT REFLECTS ITS PROCESS AND PLACE HONESTLY — PATIENT, BALANCED, AND QUIETLY COMPLEX. tasting_notes: Rich caramel and oak opening, smooth vanilla warmth, with a gentle rum-like undertone that lingers on the palate.
description_raw: This Rum Barrel Aged lot from Ratnagiri Estate is unlike anything else we roast. The green coffee spends three months aging in premium rum barrels, slowly absorbing the deep, boozy character of oak, caramel, and vanilla. When it arrived at our roastery, we knew the challenge was to honor the barrel influence without letting it overpower the cup. We landed on a medium-light roast, carefully balancing development to preserve the rum-kissed aromatics while drawing out a silky sweetness in the body. The result is a coffee that opens with rich caramel and oak, unfolds into smooth vanilla warmth, and finishes with a gentle Rum Like-like undertone that lingers on the palate. It’s decadent, layered, and playful—a coffee that blurs the line between tradition and innovation, crafted for those who want an experience as memorable as it is flavorful. tasting_notes: A vibrant yet approachable cup with wet coconut creaminess, blackcurrant-like gooseberry brightness, smooth milk chocolate depth, and a lemon zest finish.
description_raw: From the lush slopes of Melkodige Estate , this washed Chandragiri lot stood out to us immediately for its unusual mix of tropical creaminess and crisp fruit vibrancy . It’s not every day you find a coffee where wet coconut and blackcurrant-like notes coexist so naturally—and we knew the roast had to highlight that playful balance. description_raw: Premium Coffee Blend for Cold Brew & Filter Coffee Lovers – Caffena CA*7/3 Featuring 70% Arabica AAA ( Mysore Nuggets from C&T Estate ) and 30% powerful Robusta beans ( from Baarbara Estate ), Caffena CA*7/3 is a well-designed mix of the finest washed-process coffee powders . Perfect for those seeking the best coffee in India , this premium coffee powder boasts nutty overtones and controlled acidity . Rich Flavor Profile Indulge in the deep cocoa and almond notes from our medium-dark roast , making it a fantastic choice for cold brew coffee, frappuccinos, and other cold coffee variations . With an exceptional 80+ cupping score , Caffena CA*7/3 is crafted for coffee connoisseurs who desire strength, flavor, and full-bodied richness in their cup. Why Choose Caffena CA*7/3? ✔ Perfect for frappuccinos and cold-brew coffee ✔ Ideal for coffee makers and machines using filters ✔ Premium-quality coffee powder sourced from the 1500m altitude Coorg & Chikmagalur regions ✔ Rich cocoa and almond notes help balance acidity ✔ Washed procedure guarantees a smooth and pure taste With its outstanding taste and consistency , Caffena CA*7/3 stands out among India’s top coffee brands , whether you're making fresh filter coffee or using a coffee maker machine

coffee_name: Chariot New York Espresso Coffee Beans
tasting_notes: Rich and intense with roasted nuts, dark chocolate, and cedar, producing a thick creamy crema.
description_raw: Flavor Notes - Roasted Nuts, Dark Chocolate, Cedar Altitude - 950 - 1700 MASL Espresso coffee beans are specifically roasted and blended to create a strong and concentrated flavor ideal for making espresso-based drinks. The beans are roasted to a darker level compared to other coffee beans, resulting in a rich and intense flavor profile. They are known for producing a thick, creamy layer of crema on top of the espresso shot, which adds to the overall taste and texture. Espresso coffee beans are commonly used in espresso machines or coffee makers equipped with a dedicated espresso brewing function. Due to their strong flavor, espresso coffee beans are also used as a base for various espresso-based beverages such as cappuccinos, lattes, and macchiatos.

coffee_name: Premium Arabica Coffee Beans – Caramel, Dark Chocolate, Walnut & Vanilla Notes | Medium Roast Whole Bean Coffee
tasting_notes: Balanced and aromatic with caramel sweetness, dark chocolate depth, nutty walnut, and a smooth vanilla finish.
description_raw: 100% Arabica Coffee Beans – Carefully sourced and expertly roasted for consistent quality Rich Flavor Profile – Notes of caramel sweetness, dark chocolate depth, nutty walnut, and smooth vanilla finish Medium Roast – Balanced body, mild acidity, and rich aroma Whole Bean Freshness – Grind fresh for maximum flavor and aroma Smooth & Aromatic – Perfect for both black coffee and milk-based drinks Versatile Brewing – Suitable for espresso, French press, pour-over, drip, and cold brew

tasting_notes: A refined cup with fruity sweetness and a silky, smooth body.
description_raw: Single-Origin Baarbara Estate – Sourced from one of India’s most celebrated high-altitude coffee estates. Light to Medium Roast – Balanced roasting preserves natural sweetness and aroma. 100% Premium Arabica Beans – Handpicked, expertly processed, and roasted for consistent quality Anaerobic Fermented – Specialty processing that boosts fruity depth and cup vibrancy. Perfect for All Brew Methods – Ideal for pour-over, French press, Aeropress, espresso, and cold brew. Crafted for Specialty Coffee Lovers – A refined cup experience with fruity sweetness and silky body.

tasting_notes: Balanced and chocolate-forward with rich brown butter sweetness, dark chocolate depth, and delicate floral elegance.
description_raw: About This Coffee Some origins are legendary for a reason. Colombian coffee has been the gold standard for generations—balanced, approachable, endlessly drinkable. Our Azahar lot comes from Colombia's famed coffee regions, where volcanic soil and perfect altitude create beans that taste like what coffee is supposed to taste like. Tasting Notes Brown Butter | Chocolate | Florals Rich brown butter opens the cup, dark chocolate provides depth, and delicate florals add elegance. This is Colombian coffee at its finest—nothing too extreme, everything perfectly balanced. Coffee Specifications Category: CC Origins – International Coffee Origin: Azahar Estate, Colombia Process: Semi Washed (Traditional Colombian Method) Roast Level: Medium Light Flavor Profile: Balanced, chocolate-forward, subtle florals Best For: Pour Over, Drip Coffee, French Press, Espresso Acidity: Medium, smooth Body: Medium to full, creamy Perfect For Anyone new to specialty coffee, or anyone who wants to remember why they fell in love with coffee in the first place. This is approachable excellence.

coffee_name: Ratnagiri Whiskey Barrel Aged – Light Roast NanoLot
tasting_notes: Oak-forward with smooth vanilla sweetness and malt complexity reminiscent of a fine single malt whiskey.
description_raw: About This Coffee This is coffee for the whiskey lovers, the experimentalists, the "I can't believe this is real" coffee drinkers. Green coffee beans aged in whiskey barrels absorb the wood, the spirit residue, the entire character of what came before—creating something that's 100% coffee but tastes like it went to finishing school in Scotland. Tasting Notes Oak | Vanilla | Malt Rich oak from the barrel aging, smooth vanilla sweetness, and malt complexity that reminds you of a fine single malt. This doesn't taste like whiskey—it tastes like coffee that learned from whiskey. Coffee Specifications Category: CC Reserve – National Origins (Nano Lot) Origin: Ratnagiri Estate, Chikmagalur, Karnataka Process: Whiskey Barrel Aged (Specialty Process) Roast Level: Light Flavor Profile: Oak-forward, vanilla sweetness, malt complexity Best For: Pour Over, Aeropress, French Press (savored slowly) Acidity: Low to medium Body: Full, creamy Perfect For Coffee lovers who also love whiskey. Gift-worthy, conversation-starting, "you have to try this" coffee. Warning: It's addictive and extremely limited.

coffee_name: Baarbara Mixed Fruit Fermentation – Medium Light Roast Microlot
tasting_notes: Layered and complex with crisp apple freshness, pomegranate tang, black tea elegance, and a chocolate finish.
description_raw: About This Coffee What happens when coffee cherries ferment alongside carefully selected fruits? This experimental lot from Baarbara Estate is the answer—a controlled mixed-fruit fermentation that creates a cup so complex, you'll keep coming back trying to identify every note. This is coffee innovation at its most delicious. Tasting Notes Apple | Pomegranate | Black Tea | Chocolate It starts with crisp apple freshness, transitions to pomegranate tang, mellows into black tea elegance, and finishes with familiar chocolate comfort. It's like tasting coffee's entire possibility spectrum in one cup. Coffee Specifications Category: CC Reserve – National Origins (Microlot) Origin: Baarbara Estate, Chikmagalur, Karnataka Process: Mixed Fruit Fermentation (Experimental) Roast Level: Medium Light Flavor Profile: Layered fruit notes, tea-like, balanced chocolate finish Best For: Pour Over, Chemex, French Press, Cold Brew Acidity: Medium, bright but balanced Body: Medium, complex Perfect For Coffee explorers who want something truly unique. This is limited-run innovation—once it's gone, it might never be exactly the same again.

coffee_name: Baarbara Intenso Naturals – Light Roast Microlot
tasting_notes: Intense and berry-forward with fresh blueberry sweetness, raw cacao depth, and a unique marigold floral note.
description_raw: About This Coffee Same legendary Baarbara Estate, completely different expression. While their washed coffees are clean and chocolate-forward, Intenso Naturals goes wild—in the best way. This is what happens when ripe cherries are dried with the fruit still on, concentrating sugars and creating flavors that taste almost fermented, almost boozy, almost dessert-like. Tasting Notes Blueberry | Raw Cacao | Marigold Imagine fresh blueberries with raw cacao nibs, finished with marigold's unique floral note. It's intense without being overwhelming, fruit-forward without being candy-like. This is natural processing done right. Coffee Specifications Category: CC Reserve – National Origins (Microlot) Origin: Baarbara Estate, Chikmagalur, Karnataka Process: Intenso Yeast Naturals (Extended Fermentation) Roast Level: Light Flavor Profile : Berry-forward, chocolate undertones, floral complexity Best For: Pour Over, Aeropress, Cold Brew, V60 Acidity: Medium-high, fruit-like Body: Medium, juicy Perfect For Anyone who thinks they don't like "fruity" coffee—this will change your mind. It's fruit-forward but grounded, complex but approachable.

coffee_name: Attikan Culture Process – Light Roast Microlot
tasting_notes: Beautifully complex with fresh strawberry sweetness, red wine depth, chamomile florals, and a lingering grape finish.
description_raw: About This Coffee Attikan Estate asked themselves: "What if we treated coffee processing like winemaking?" The answer is this beautifully complex microlot where cultured naturals create flavors that blur the line between coffee and fruit infusion. This is for the adventurous—those who want their morning cup to transport them somewhere completely new. Tasting Notes Strawberry | Red Wine | Chamomile | Grapes Close your eyes. Is it coffee? Is it dessert? It's both. Fresh strawberry sweetness meets red wine complexity, with chamomile's floral whisper and grape finish. This is coffee that starts conversations. Coffee Specifications Category: CC Reserve – National Origins (Microlot) Origin: Attikan Estate, Biligiri Ranjan Hills, Karnataka Process: Cultured Naturals (Controlled Fermentation) Roast Level: Light Flavor Profile: Fruit-forward, floral, wine-like, incredibly complex Best For: Pour Over, Chemex, Cold Brew, Specialty Filter Methods Acidity: Bright, lively Body: Medium, silky Perfect For The coffee lover who also loves wine, tea, and anything that makes them say "how did they DO that?" Not for beginners—this is graduate-level coffee.

coffee_name: Ratnagiri Yeast Carbonic Naturals – Light Roast Microlot
tasting_notes: Fruit-forward and wine-like with red grape sweetness, mulberry depth, bright lemon peel, and a nougat finish.
description_raw: About This Coffee This isn't your grandmother's coffee (unless your grandmother is a fermentation scientist). Ratnagiri Yeast Carbonic Naturals represents the cutting edge of coffee processing—where controlled fermentation unlocks flavors you didn't know coffee could have. This is coffee for the curious, the experimental, the "wait, what am I tasting?" crowd. Tasting Notes Red Grape | Mulberry | Lemon Peel | Nougat Think wine country meets coffee estate. Red grape sweetness dances with mulberry depth, while lemon peel adds brightness and nougat brings it all together. This is fruit-forward coffee that still remembers it's coffee. Coffee Specifications Category: CC Reserve – National Origins (Microlot) Origin: Ratnagiri Estate, Chikmagalur, Karnataka Process: Yeast Carbonic Naturals (Anaerobic Fermentation) Roast Level: Light Flavor Profile: Fruit-forward, wine-like complexity, bright and clean Best For: Pour Over, V60, Aeropress, Light Filter Methods Acidity: Bright, sparkling Body: Light to medium, tea-like Perfect For Coffee geeks, flavor chasers, and anyone who thinks "coffee is just coffee" until they try this. Warning: This might ruin regular coffee for you.
